card.summary: The International Nuclear Energy Act of 2025 aims to create a coordinated, whole-of-government approach for U.S. international nuclear cooperation, nuclear exports, and advanced nuclear reactor technology. The bill establishes new White House coordination offices, working groups, and grant programs to assist countries developing civil nuclear programs while promoting U.S. nuclear companies and technologies abroad.
